name: Lyo.Result
tagline: `Result` / `Result<T>` with `Error` graphs, builders, bulk/paged envelopes, and `Task` composition. Distinct from `Lyo.Common.Core` `Result`.
description: `Result` / `Result<T>` and related types. Distinct from [`Lyo.Common.Core`](../../Common/Lyo.Common.Core/README.md) `Result` (different namespace and design). Feature libraries pick `Lyo.Result` when they want `Error` graphs, builders, bulk/paged envelopes, and `Task` composition without pulling the whole API layer.

sections.title: `Result<T>` and `IResult<T>`
items: **Unwrap / extract.** `ValueOrThrow`, `TryGetValue`, `ValueOrDefault`, `Match`, `MapAsync` / `Map`, `Tap` side effects, boolean operators where defined on the record.

sections.title: `Error`
sections.text: `Error` is an immutable record with `Code`, `Message`, `Type`, and `Severity` (`ErrorType`: Validation, Generic, Conflict, NotFound, Unauthorized, and more). It also has `Exception`, `StackTrace`, `InnerError` (chained errors mimic exception chains), `Timestamp`, and `Metadata`. Factory helpers on `Error` include `Validation`, `FromException`, `Conflict`, `NotFound`, and `Unauthorized`, so call sites do not hand-roll severity/type for common cases. Validation-specific codes often flow through `ValidationErrorCodes`.

sections.title: Success with no data, and void
items: `ResultVoid` covers operation completed, no payload, alongside `Result<T>` (see `ResultVoid.cs`).
`Unit` is a typed no-value placeholder where APIs want `Result<Unit>`.

sections.title: `Option<T>`
sections.text: A missing value is not a failed operation. That is what `Option` is for, and it is not `Result`. Typical case: an optional query row.

sections.title: Results paired with the request
items: **Result<TRequest, TResult>.** Extends `Result<TResult>` with the original `TRequest` payload, so failure paths can echo back the input that produced the error. Adds `TryGetRequest`, a four-tuple `Deconstruct`, and request-aware `Failure(Exception, …)` / `Success` factories.

**BulkResult<TRequest, TResult>.** Bulk variant whose `SuccessfulResults`, `Results`, and `FailedResults` collections are paired (`Result<TRequest, TResult>`), plus `FailedRequests` / `SuccessfulRequests` projections for re-driving partial failures.

**BulkResultFromRequest<TRequest, TResult>.** A single request that expands into many per-item results (e.g. one upload to many row outcomes), with `FromResults`, `FromData`, `FromException`, and `FromErrors` helpers.

sections.title: Paging and lists
items: **BulkResult<T>.** Many operations in one round-trip with cached `FailureCount` / `SuccessCount`, `IsCompleteFailure` / `IsCompleteSuccess` / `HasPartialSuccess` flags, `ErrorMessages` / `ErrorCodes` (flattened over inner errors), `FailedData` / `SuccessfulData`, and `FromData` / `FromResults` / `FromErrors` factories.
**PagedResult.** Items as a `Result` envelope plus page metadata.

sections.title: Composition on async paths
sections.text: `AsyncResultExtensions` provides `ThenAsync` (chain `Task<Result<…>>` only on success), `OnFailureAsync` / `OnSuccessAsync`, overloads that propagate `CancellationToken`, and adapters from `Task` plus exceptions into `Result`. Use these to keep async pipelines linear without nested `if (!result.IsSuccess) return …`.

sections.title: Validation and guards
sections.text: `ValidationHelpers` and `Ensure` express preconditions and collect validation failures into `Result` / `Error` shapes (see XML docs on each file).

sections.title: Adapters from exception to Result
rows: Awaits a result-returning task and converts thrown exceptions into a failed `Result<T>`.

sections.title: Logging
sections.text: `ResultLoggingExtensions` attach log scopes for failure and success that carry the same fields your logging config can correlate.

sections.title: Infrastructure / regex
sections.text: `RegexPatterns` hosts shared validation patterns used by higher layers (route slugs, emails, and similar). Check call sites before assuming a specific regex is the product rule.

sections.title: How this relates to encryption and HTTP
items: `Lyo.Encryption` ships `DecryptionResult` / `EncryptionResult` models in this namespace for operations that want `Result` without throwing for routine failure modes.
SMS and translation envelope stacks reference `Lyo.Result` for `Error` typing in their public models.

sections.title: Related reading
items: Often returns structured failures compatible with richer error handling in hosts: [`Lyo.Validation`](../../Validation/Lyo.Validation/README.md).
Guard helpers shared with keystore and validation stacks: [`Lyo.Exceptions`](../../Lyo.Exceptions/README.md).
